entities.name: Ribosomal protein bL17
observations: The 118-residue query is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt protein B1VAC0 from Phytoplasma australiense.
The protein belongs to the Ribosomal_L17 Pfam family, with a domain spanning residues 16–117.
It is a basic, highly positively charged protein: predicted pI 10.47 and charge at pH 7 of +11.67.
Curated homolog annotations identify it as a structural constituent of the bacterial 50S large ribosomal subunit.
Curated homolog annotations state that it contacts ribosomal protein L32.

entities.name: Bacterial translation
observations: The protein is annotated with GO:0006412 (translation) through its role in the 50S ribosomal subunit.

entities.name: 50S ribosomal subunit
observations: The protein is annotated with GO:0015934 (large ribosomal subunit) and functions within the 50S ribosomal subunit.
